about_short_description.short_description: Zbooni is a technology company that provides a social commerce (cCommerce) platform enabling businesses to sell products and services.

product.name: Zbooni All-in-One Payments
product.description: A payment processing service enabling businesses to accept online payments directly through Zbooni, available in UAE, KSA, Egypt, and Jordan.

product.name: Zbooni Integrated Payments
product.description: A service that integrates merchants’ existing payment providers with Zbooni to enable commerce through chat and social channels, available worldwide.

product.name: Zbooni Commerce Platform (cCommerce)
product.description: A platform enabling businesses to sell products and services directly through chat and social messaging apps with order capture, payment, and customer engagement tools.

product.name: Zbooni Marketplace (cShop Market)
product.description: An online chat-to-shop marketplace where businesses can list products to reach a broad audience and increase sales through social commerce.

product.name: Zbooni Business Dashboard and Analytics
product.description: A dashboard providing merchants with tools to track orders, sales, customers, and business performance with reporting capabilities.
